meanings.usage: 对别人的遭遇表示理解和同情
形容人的行为恶劣或不道德
指地球或人类居住的地方
对男性的尊称或礼貌用语
指人的品质，说实话，不欺骗
对不满意的事情表达不满
用拳头或其他物体敲击门等
表示刚完成某动作，用于过去完成时
指东西不见了或弄丢了

examples.en: I lost my wallet on the bus.
examples.zh: 我在公交车上丢了钱包。

examples.en: I felt very upset when I found my money was gone.
examples.zh: 发现钱不见了时我感到非常不安。

examples.en: I left the money in my room.
She put an envelope on his desk.
examples.zh: 她把一个信封放在他桌上。

examples.en: He started to complain about this wicked world.
examples.zh: 他开始抱怨这个邪恶的世界。

examples.en: He was interrupted by a knock at the door.
I found this outside this gentleman's room.
examples.zh: 我在这位先生的房间外面发现的。

examples.en: There is still some honesty in this world.
examples.zh: 这个世界上仍然有诚实。

phrases.usage: /ðiːz deɪz/ phrase. 现在，如今（指当前这个时期）

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作，强调'过去的过去' 用于描述两个过去的动作，先发生的动作用过去完成时，后发生的动作用一般过去时

examples.en: I had just lost £50 when I went to the manager.
examples.zh: 当我去找经理时，我刚刚丢了50英镑。

examples.en: She had finished her work before she left.
examples.zh: 她在离开前已经完成了工作。

grammar.title: some在肯定句中的用法
grammar.structure: some + 可数名词复数/不可数名词
grammar.definition: some通常用于肯定句中，表示'一些，某些' some用于肯定句中可以指代不确定的数量，也可用于邀请或期望肯定回答的疑问句中

examples.en: There is still some honesty in this world.
examples.zh: 这个世界上仍然有一些诚实。

He had just arrived when I called.

imitations.zh: 现在每个人都在看比赛。

original.zh: 这个世界上仍然有诚实。

original.en: I found this outside this gentleman's room.
original.zh: 我在这位先生的房间外面发现的。

imitations.en: I found this outside Mary's office.
imitations.zh: 我在玛丽的办公室外面发现的。

imitations.en: He found the key outside the classroom.
imitations.zh: 他在教室外面发现的钥匙。

lines.en: I entered the hotel manager's office and sat down.
lines.zh: 我走进饭店经理的办公室，坐了下来。

lines.en: I had just lost $50 and I felt very upset.
lines.zh: 我刚刚丢了50英镑，感到非常烦恼。

lines.en: 'I left the money in my room,' I said, 'and it's not there now.
lines.zh: “我把钱放在房间里，”我说，“可现在没有了。

lines.en: The manager was sympathetic , but he could do nothing.
lines.zh: ”经理深表同情，但却无能为力。

lines.en: 'Everyone's losing money these days,' he said.
He started to complain about this wicked world but was interrupted by a knock at the door.
lines.zh: 他开始抱怨起这个邪恶的世道来，却被一阵敲门声打断了。

lines.en: A girl came in and put an envelope on his desk.
lines.zh: 一个姑娘走了进来，把一个信封放在了他桌上。

lines.en: 'I found this outside this gentleman's room,' she said.
lines.zh: “这是我在这位先生的房门外捡到的，”她说。

lines.en: 'Well,' I said to the manager, 'there is still some honesty in this world!'
lines.zh: “是啊，”我对那位经理说，“这世界上还是有诚实可言的！”

questions.q: Had the writer's money been stolen?
questions.a: No, it had not been stolen. A girl found it outside his room and brought it back in an envelope, which she put on the manager's desk.
questions.aZh: 没有。钱并没有被偷，是一个姑娘在他房门外捡到，装进信封送到了经理的桌上。
questions.hint: 见 A girl came in and put an envelope on his desk. It contained £50。

questions.q: Why did the writer go to the hotel manager's office, and how did he feel?
questions.zh: 作者为什么走进饭店经理的办公室？他当时的心情如何？
questions.a: Because he had just lost £50 and the money he had left in his room was not there any more. He felt very upset.
questions.aZh: 因为他刚丢了50英镑，留在房间里的钱不见了，他感到非常烦恼。
questions.hint: 见课文前两句 I entered the hotel manager's office and sat down。had lost 是过去完成时。

questions.q: How did the manager react when he heard that the money was gone?
questions.zh: 听说钱不见了，经理是什么反应？
questions.a: He was sympathetic, but he could do nothing. He said everyone was losing money these days, and then he started to complain about this wicked world.
questions.aZh: 他深表同情却无能为力，说现在大家都在丢钱，接着抱怨起这个邪恶的世道来。
questions.hint: 见 The manager was sympathetic, but he could do nothing。

questions.q: What did the girl bring into the office, and where had she found it?
questions.zh: 姑娘拿来了什么？她是在哪里捡到的？
questions.a: She brought in an envelope which contained £50. She had found it outside the gentleman's room.
questions.aZh: 她拿来一只装着50英镑的信封，是她在这位先生的房门外捡到的。
questions.hint: 见 It contained £50. 与 'I found this outside this gentleman's room,' she said。

questions.q: The manager had just called the world wicked, yet minutes later the money was returned. Why does the writer say 'there is still some honesty in this world'?
questions.zh: 经理刚抱怨完世道邪恶，钱就被送了回来。作者为什么说“这世界上还是有诚实可言的”？
questions.a: The girl's act of handing in the money contradicts the manager's complaint: the world is not wholly wicked. The writer means that things could have been worse — the money could have been stolen, but it had only been dropped and returned.
questions.aZh: 姑娘拾金不昧，正好反驳了经理“世道邪恶”的说法。作者的意思是事情本来可能更糟：钱真被偷走才叫糟，如今只是掉了又被送回。
questions.hint: 联系 He started to complain about this wicked world 与末句。

translation:
我走进饭店经理的办公室，坐了下来。
我刚刚丢了50英镑，感到非常烦恼。
“我把钱放在房间里，”我说，“可现在没有了。
”经理深表同情，但却无能为力。
“现在大家都在丢钱，”他说。
他开始抱怨起这个邪恶的世道来，却被一阵敲门声打断了。
一个姑娘走了进来，把一个信封放在了他桌上。
它里面装着50英镑。
“这是我在这位先生的房门外捡到的，”她说。
“是啊，”我对那位经理说，“这世界上还是有诚实可言的！”
title: It Could Be Worse
subtitle: 不幸中之万幸

lead.question: 丢了50英镑的作者为何最后反而感叹世上仍有诚实可言？
lead.warmup: 住店丢了钱，第一反应多半是被人偷了。作者正是如此：他刚丢了50英镑，心烦意乱地走进经理的办公室，说钱明明留在房里却不见了。经理深表同情却无能为力，感叹如今人人都丢钱，还抱怨起这个邪恶的世道。敲门声打断了他——一个姑娘送来一只信封，里面正是那50英镑，是她在他房门外捡到的。
goals: 复述课文：能用英语讲清丢钱、投诉、送还的情节与结尾的反转
掌握 upset、sympathetic、complain about、wicked、contain、honesty 等本课词汇与搭配
辨清 could have been（本来可能）与 must have been（一定是）的推测语气差别
学会 start to do、could do nothing、a knock at the door 等本课句型
lead.summary: 全文十句，写成一篇微型喜剧。过去完成时 I had just lost £50 与 felt very upset 先交待困境；经理 sympathetic 却 could do nothing，用现在进行时夸张地说 Everyone's losing money these days，又抱怨 this wicked world，话音未落便被 a knock at the door 打断；信封里躺着的 £50 一举推翻“被偷”的猜想，末句 there is still some honesty in this world 点题。
lead.tips: 易错：could have done 表“本来可能发生却并未发生”，如 The money could have been stolen；must have been 表“一定是”，语气肯定得多。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我走进饭店经理的办公室，坐了下来。
exercises.a: I entered the hotel manager's office and sat down.
exercises.note: hotel manager's 用名词所有格。

exercises.q: 填空：I had just lost £50 and I felt very ______. The manager was ______ (sympathy), but he could do nothing.
exercises.note: feel upset 心烦；sympathy 的形容词是 sympathetic。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他开始抱怨起这个邪恶的世道来，却被一阵敲门声打断了。
exercises.a: He started to complain about this wicked world but was interrupted by a knock at the door.
exercises.note: start to do；complain about；a knock at the door。

exercises.q: 改错：He started complaining this wicked world.
exercises.a: He started to complain about this wicked world.

exercises.q: 汉译英：一个姑娘走了进来，把一个信封放在他桌上，里面装着50英镑。
exercises.a: A girl came in and put an envelope on his desk. It contained £50.

exercises.q: 填空：The money ______ ______ ______ stolen（本来可能被偷，实际并没有）; it ______ ______ ______ returned by someone honest（一定是被好心人送还的）。
exercises.a: could have been; must have been
exercises.note: could 表本来可能，must 表肯定推测。

exercises.q: 汉译英：“这世界上还是有诚实可言的！”我对经理说。
exercises.a: 'There is still some honesty in this world!' I said to the manager.
exercises.note: honesty 是 honest 的名词形式。

quiz.q: “信封里装着50英镑。”课文原句是？
options: It contained £50.
It contained of £50.
It was contained £50.
It was containing of £50.
quiz.note: contain 是及物动词，不加介词。

quiz.q: “经理深表同情，但却无能为力。”课文原句是？
options: The manager was sympathy, but he could do nothing.
The manager was sympathetic, but he could do anything.
The manager was sympathetic, but he could do nothing.
The manager sympathized, but he can do nothing.

quiz.q: “钱本来可能被偷了（实际并没有）。”下列哪句正确？
options: The money could be stolen.
The money could have been stolen.
The money must be stolen.
The money had stolen.
quiz.note: could have been 表本来可能发生却未发生。

quiz.q: “他开始抱怨这个邪恶的世道。”下列哪句正确？
options: He started to complain about this wicked world.
He started complaining this wicked world.
He started to complain this wicked world.
He started complain about this wicked world.
quiz.note: complain 后须加 about/of 再接宾语。

quiz.q: 课文里“他被一阵敲门声打断了”，英文是？
options: He was interrupted by a knock of the door.
He was interrupted by a knock at the door.
He interrupted by a knock at the door.
He was interrupted by knocking the door.
quiz.note: 敲门声用 a knock at the door。

quiz.q: 作者丢失的50英镑后来去了哪里？
options: It was stolen by the hotel manager.
It had been dropped outside his room and was found by a girl.
It was still lying in his room.
The girl took it away with her.
quiz.note: 见 I found this outside this gentleman's room。
